rows.note: Use this specifically when marking or grading tests and school assignments.

example.english: I have to mark papers today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 goi2 gyun2

rows.note: Use this for a school or test mark, rather than a physical or written mark.

example.english: My mark on this test was ninety.
example.traditional: 我今次份試卷嘅成績係九十分。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 fan6 si3 gyun2 ge3 sing4 zik1 hai6 gau2 sap6 fan1

rows.note: Use this to indicate information, prices, or a location, especially on a sign or diagram.

example.english: This diagram is used to mark the location of the exit.
example.traditional: 呢幅圖清楚標示出口位置。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 tou4 cing1 co2 biu1 si6 ceot1 hau2 wai6 zi3

rows.note: Use this for a mark on a scale or measuring container, such as the 500 ml mark.

example.english: The measuring cup has a mark at five hundred millilitres.
example.traditional: 個量杯嘅刻度去到五百毫升。
example.jyutping: go3 loeng4 bui1 ge3 hak1 dou6 heoi3 dou3 ng5 baak3 hou4 sing1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a visible physical mark, trace, scratch, or stain.

example.english: There is a clear mark on the table.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 jau5 tiu4 ming4 hin2 ge3 han4 zik1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken expression for putting a mark on something or marking a place for reference.

example.english: I’ll mark this spot on the map so I can find it again next time.
example.traditional: 我喺地圖上呢個位做記號，方便下次搵返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 dei6 tou4 soeng6 ni1 go3 wai2 zou6 gei3 hou6 fong1 bin6 haa6 ci3 wan2 faan1

rows.note: Use this for a written symbol or typographical mark, including a diacritic.

example.english: This mark means you cannot park.
example.traditional: 呢個符號代表唔可以停車。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fu4 hou6 doi6 biu2 m4 ho2 ji5 ting4 ce1

rows.note: Use this when something leaves a visible or often unwanted mark behind.

example.english: After removing the tape, it left a mark on the tabletop.
example.traditional: 撕走張膠紙之後，枱面留低痕跡。
example.jyutping: si1 zau2 zoeng1 gaau1 zi2 zi1 hau6 toi2 min6 lau4 dai1 han4 zik1
